steps.say: Plants have different parts. Each part has a job.
The roots grow under the soil. They hold the plant and take in water.
The stem holds the plant up. It carries water to the leaves.
Leaves are often green and flat. They use light to make food.

figure.alt: A green leaf in the sunlight.

steps.say: The flower makes seeds. New plants grow from the seeds.

check.prompt: Which part takes in water from the soil?
hints: Think about which part is in the soil.
Water is in the soil, under the ground.
Ask: which part grows down into the soil?
check.explanation: The roots grow in the soil and take in water for the plant.

hints: This part joins the roots to the leaves.
It is long and stands up straight.
Think about the part you hold when you pick a flower.
check.explanation: The stem holds the plant up. It also carries water from the roots to the leaves.
